Record the ABHA number at the first visit, keep documentation clean for BSKY and insurance claims, and find any patient's full history — including referrals from other districts — in a couple of clicks.

localContext: In Bhubaneswar the front desk usually works in Odia, with Hindi and English common in the larger Jaydev Vihar hospitals and corporate diagnostic chains. A receptionist in Saheed Nagar or Old Town shouldn't slow down because the software is hard to follow — Lucoze runs in English, in short plain labels, and onboarding trains your desk on your own patients, so a name, UHID or mobile number brings up the record. Support is remote-first from our team in Konnagar, Hooghly, with on-site help for larger hospital rollouts. As the state capital and a fast-growing health and education hub, Bhubaneswar draws patients in from every district — many seen once and then again months later, so an ABHA number recorded at the first visit means a patient's details are on file instead of starting from a blank register. Counters here run largely on cash and UPI, and WhatsApp reminders are set up during onboarding, which is where most patients actually read them.

faqs.q: Will an Odia-speaking front desk manage?
faqs.a: Yes. Lucoze's screens are in English, in short plain words a new receptionist can follow. Onboarding trains your Bhubaneswar front desk on your own patients, so the first week runs on your real day, not a demo.

faqs.q: Do you offer setup support in Bhubaneswar?
faqs.a: Yes, remote-first. Our team sits in Konnagar, Hooghly (WB), so we onboard Bhubaneswar clinics over video, migrate your data from old registers or Excel, and stay reachable on WhatsApp and phone. For a larger hospital rollout we can arrange on-site support — just tell us what you need.

faqs.q: Where is our patient data stored?
faqs.a: On servers inside India, under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023. And there's no lock-in — export everything to CSV or PDF whenever you like, so your Bhubaneswar clinic's data always stays yours.

faqs.q: We see patients from across Odisha — can we pull up their history on a repeat visit?
faqs.a: Yes. Record the ABHA number at the first visit and Lucoze keeps that patient's full record — prescriptions, lab reports, past visits — in one place. When they travel back to Bhubaneswar months later, search by name or mobile number and their history is right there, whichever of your branches they first registered at.
